div.div:
Security and operating notes
• OCI NSGs allow only approved ingress/egress
• Passwords remain in session memory; no secrets in Git or SQLite
• Read-only default; policy + two-person approval for controlled changes
• AI creates proposals only; all requests pass schema, SQL and OEM authorization checks
• Schedules require an active authenticated session; OEM audit is authoritative
